name: larb-week8-p2a-qualification-v1
basis: week8/PLAN.md: qualify the serving workload, then calibrate the deadline band, then freeze P2 or stop.
week7/scaled-serving/reports/P1-REPORT.md: the 2025-2026 pool fails the preview; the 2023-2024 screen carries a slope; the 180 s calibration has no usable band and 240 s is the pre-declared fallback.

slo.rationale: P1 Gate F found no 15-40% band at 180 s (0% at 800/h, 74.7% at 931/h) and the report names 240 s as the practical fallback. The deadline is frozen here before any qualification measurement.
slo.no_band_policy: Adjust the arrival rate within the pre-declared grid. Do not move the deadline after seeing miss rates.

preview.deadline_note: Quality gate only; no SLO claim is made from the preview.

near_miss.action: run the pre-declared 48-item escalation preview before deciding
near_miss.note: At 24 items one answer is 4.17 points, so 5 points is not representable; a one-answer gain is the smallest slope signal and triggers the larger preview.

stop.rule: gain below 5 points, accuracy_8k below 0.30, cap_rate_8k above 0.25, or a grader/coverage failure
stop.action: write a documented stop; do not calibrate or run P2

calibration.reference_selection: hash-ranked main-cohort ids, disjoint from the preview
calibration.rate_grid_rationale: P1 at 180 s places the knee between 800/h (0%) and 931/h (74.7%); 240 s moves it right. Omni-MATH may be slower than the screen, so the grid extends down to 600/h to catch a left-shifted knee, and up to 1200/h to bracket a right-shifted one.

refinement.rule: If no rate is in band, use the midpoint between the highest sub-band rate and the lowest over-band rate, plus one step on each side; the same band and target apply.
refinement.after_refinement: If no rate is in band, stop and report the bracket; do not move the deadline.

requirements: pressure fraction at waiting >= 8 is positive
no cut after the close token
at least one 4096 admission and one 8192 admission
live_check.failure_action: documented stop; the live mechanism is not validated

seed_reduction_rule.rule: Choose the largest seed count whose estimated arrival span plus the low control, times the overhead factor, is at most target_inner_hours. If none fits, stop and split rather than overrun the 15 h inner allocation.
seed_reduction_rule.note: This is an operational wall-time rule, not an outcome-dependent scientific threshold. The realised seed count and MDE must be reported.

freeze_requires: source lock and trace hashes verified

decision.go: preview pass AND calibration band AND live check pass
decision.stop: any one of the three fails; the stop is recorded with the evidence
